notes.title: New Update is Live!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087854/84fbcee2fed85a0d8a0b6578764a93673c37cf63.png

We’re thrilled to announce a fresh update for Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number!

Here’s what’s new:
🎮 Keyboard Mode: You can now enable keyboard mode in settings for a new way to play!
📜 Key Bindings List: Check out the updated settings dialog for a full list of key bindings, plus some new options to enhance your gameplay.
🔄 Customizable Controls: Added an option to invert RMB and MMB in standard mode, giving you more flexibility.
🎨 Color Tile Automatization: Your first color is now set automatically at the start, and colors will auto-change after finishing the current one!
📊 Color Tile Info: See the number of pixels left in a color directly on its tile for easier progress tracking.

💡 Don’t forget to leave us your feedback and reviews on Steam! Your thoughts inspire future updates.

🎁 Exciting News!
Don’t forget - this Thursday, we have a FREE DLC dropping for Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number! 🥳 Make sure to check it out and enhance your creative journey even more.

🎄 Wishlist Alert!
As the holiday season approaches, so does our next game, There's No Santa! 🎅 A perfect mix of festive vibes and fun - make sure to add it to your wishlist and get ready for some holiday cheer.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3192350/Theres_No_Santa
